title: Rust no_std SCHC authority can mint caller-asserted trust
description: Public PeerContextAuthority::issue_verified accepts arbitrary signer/counter/version/receipt facts, while public LinkVerifiedFragment exposes freely constructible fields. Any downstream can construct its own authority, mint an authenticated peer, and drive authenticated sender/receiver APIs without signature, source, root, destination, or clock verification. Under std such contexts can also panic via authenticated_frame(). Replace caller-asserted facts with an owner-issued no_std Link evidence capability/trait sealed to the Link TCB, prevent std misuse, and add compile-fail/forgery tests.
notes: In std builds issue_verified creates a public context with evidence=None; authenticated_frame() then panics via expect. Besides trust minting, make evidence-less states unrepresentable or return Result/Option and remove cfg(test) bypasses.
